findings.scenario: The provider or network fails during a presentation, then recovers with queued submissions.
findings.gap: Offline fixture is promised, but failover, stale-input, and recovery rules are absent.
findings.recommendation: Define health signals and offline controls; discard or revalidate queued actions and document safe recovery/rollback.

findings.scenario: The stage presents a plan rehearsal, fixture, replay, or match as evidence.
findings.gap: No provenance labels distinguish critique, fixture events, simulated bounty, and observed outcomes.
findings.recommendation: Label source and mode on views/exports, mark bounty simulated with no payout, and preserve event IDs and phase times.

findings.scenario: Audience reads fictional Twitch or IVS concepts as integrations or sponsorship.
findings.gap: Stage copy, brand assets, and data disclosures are unspecified.
findings.recommendation: Label concepts simulated, use only approved assets, and disclose no affiliation or live platform data.

findings.scenario: A route or service delay threatens the event deadline during the 20/5/5 loop.
findings.gap: There is no show runbook, hard-stop policy, or mode-switch authority.
findings.recommendation: Set the demo budget, cue/hold/restart controls, and labeled offline fallback so the show ends on time without implying success.
